visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up shot of two hands wearing black gloves holding a large, juicy burger with a smashed beef patty and melted yellow cheese over a silver tray. The background shows a dimly lit restaurant environment with a large drink in a glass. (2) A staff member wearing a white t-shirt, a surgical mask, and black gloves serves a tray containing two burgers and a side of fries to a customer at a lit counter. The camera pans slightly as the tray is handed over to the patron. (3) On a hot, flat-top grill, multiple beef patties topped with sliced onions are being pressed down with a heavy iron burger smasher. Steam billows up around the meat as it sizzles on the dark metal surface in the busy kitchen. (4) A macro shot reveals the internal layers of a burger after a bite has been taken, showing the pink, medium-cooked beef patty, melted cheese, fresh green lettuce, red tomato slices, and a thick, creamy sauce on a toasted bun. (5) In a professional kitchen setting, gloved hands handle large slabs of raw, marbled red beef on a white plastic tray. The camera then switches to show the meat being hand-rolled into uniform balls in preparation for the hot grill. (6) A finger presses down on the top of a burger, causing meat juices and sauce to drip down the sides of the stacked beef patties and melted cheese, emphasizing the texture and freshness of the food in a close-up. (7) Close-up views of the 'Good G Burger' menu items, including a burger topped with a thick layer of crunchy peanut butter and crispy bacon strips, along with fresh lettuce and tomato. The lighting is bright and focused on the food. (8) A piece of golden-brown fried chicken is pulled apart by hands in gloves, revealing the steaming, juicy white meat inside. The crispy breading flakes off as the meat is shredded, showcasing the tender and succulent texture of the poultry. (9) A tall glass of creamy black sesame milkshake with a thick texture is shown on a wooden table, followed by a root beer float topped with two scoops of melting vanilla ice cream and a wooden spoon in a glass. (10) The camera provides a wide view of the restaurant's interior, featuring wooden tables, chairs, and customers dining. The walls are decorated with colorful posters and shelves holding collectible items, creating a relaxed and trendy American-style diner atmosphere. (11) The video concludes with a shot of the restaurant's storefront during the day, showing the 'Good G Burger' sign with a cartoon logo and the address '303 Sanmin Road, Fengshan District, Kaohsiung City' displayed prominently.
